name: Taming Your Tongue
overview: Scripture emphasizes the critical importance of controlling our speech, urging believers to guard their tongues against evil and deceit while speaking with wisdom and healing. The Psalms call for God’s help in watching over our words, recognizing the mouth as a gateway that must be carefully managed. Proverbs highlights that restraint in speech reflects wisdom, and that gentle, wholesome words can bring life and peace, whereas harsh or excessive words lead to sin and strife. Together, these verses teach that taming the tongue is essential for spiritual health and godly living.
